Topic Of The Week: What is your favorite blush?
Maybelline Dream Bouncy Blush in Fresh Pink. I really like the light feel, and it's easy to blend.

I either use NYX HD Blush ($6.99) or Stila Convertible Color ($25.00). I got the Stila convertible color on sale and thought I'd try it....I'm not convinced it's worth $25.00 but if you see it on sale it's worth picking up. I got them at an Ulta so I don't think they ship internationally but I'm sure other places like Sephora or something would carry these items.

I've been using the Nyx HD blush for a while and I love it, too. Good to know about the convertible colors - I had been debating them forever and didn't really love any of the color options. Do you know if they even stay as well as they claim to?

I haven't noticed it wearing out. One thing i can say for sure is that a little bit goes a long way so it will probably last you a while. I was originally going to get it in a darker color like Poppy and when I saw it in person I 'noped' out and got Lillium which seems pinker in person so I understand how it's hard to pick a color haha. i'd say if you don't like the colors go for a different blush? for $26 you can get Two Faced Love Flush Blush and it comes in a heart shaped compact!
